title: Settings
description: Manage your profile, security, preferences and data.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to people you share projects with.

security.password_description: Changing your password signs you out on every device, including this one.
security.password_hint: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a number.
security.google_only_password: You sign in with Google, so your account has no password yet. Set one first through "Forgot password".
security.email_description: We'll send a link to the new address. Your email changes only after you open it.
security.google_only_email: To change your email, set a password first through "Forgot password".
security.google_description: Sign in with Google instead of a password.
security.google_how: To connect Google, log out, then choose "Continue with Google" with the same email address.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
preferences.citation_hint: Used for exports and in-text citations.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.description: Choose which emails we send you. Changes are saved straight away.
notifications.security_note: Security emails (new sign-ins, password and email changes) are always sent and can't be turned off.

processing_done.label: Sources ready
processing_done.description: When your uploaded sources have finished processing.

report_ready.label: Reports ready
report_ready.description: When a synthesis or gap report you started is ready.

project_invite.label: Project invitations
project_invite.description: When someone invites you to a project.

weekly_digest.label: Weekly digest
weekly_digest.description: A short summary of activity in your projects.

data.delete_description: Your account and projects are deleted after 30 days. Until then you can contact us to restore it.
data.delete_dialog_body: You'll be signed out on every device. After 30 days your account and all its projects are permanently deleted.
data.google_only: To delete your account, set a password first through "Forgot password", then come back here.
